source_reachability:
All fetched by me on 2026-09-16 with curl -A "Mokaair-editorial", no personal data in any request. Body inspected every time; canonical <link> compared to the requested URL on all eight press releases. NOTHING was blocked.

apple.com/newsroom/rss-feed.rss -> 200, 18825 B, Atom, 20 <entry>, newest 2026-09-16T13:59:28.902Z. Real feed.
apple.com/tw/newsroom/rss-feed.rss -> 200, 18232 B, Atom, 20 <entry>, newest 2026-09-15T18:24:34.522Z. Real feed.
TW iPhone 18 Pro -> 200, 272001 B, canonical matches.
TW Watch Series 12 -> 200, 331776 B, canonical matches.
TW Watch Ultra 4 -> 200, 272622 B, canonical matches.
TW AirPods 5 (…-featuring-…) -> 200, 183298 B, canonical matches; the TW slug really is "featuring", the US slug "with".
US iPhone 18 Pro -> 200, 298988 B; US Series 12 -> 200, 408303 B; US Ultra 4 -> 200, 344485 B; US AirPods 5 -> 200, 197112 B. All canonicals match.
support.apple.com/zh-tw/118210 -> 200, 164398 B, canonical matches, BUT the page is titled 「可搭配 Apple Fitness+ 使用的裝置」 — it is NOT the hypertension feature-availability page the TW watch footnote sends readers to. The researcher's observation is correct; I confirm it.
apple.com/tw/watchos/feature-availability/ -> 200, 271368 B, real content (not a shell). Has a 「健康：高血壓通知」 section with 183 territory entries; 台灣 is listed as 「台灣7」, footnote 7 = 「『高血壓通知』功能可能不適用於你所在地區的 Apple Watch Series 12 或 Apple Watch Ultra 4，這些裝置尚待監管機構進行額外的審核。」 No date on this page. Live page, read 2026-09-16.

CAVEAT ON SCOPE: the researcher output handed to me was truncated mid-sentence at 「Apple Watch Series 12 台灣售價 NT$13,900 起；美國起價 399 美元。","is_vendo». I audited the 34 visible verified_facts plus sourcing_verdict / sourcing_notes / sources / event_date_basis. Every Series 12 / Ultra 4 / AirPods 5 fact after that point is UNAUDITED. I fetched those four pages anyway and put their key figures in additional_findings so a second pass can check them.

unsupported.fact: 美國版…eSIM 專用機型…Pro Max 充滿電最長可用 30 小時 — the 30-hour figure recorded inside the eSIM-only qualifier
unsupported.why: The US page attaches 'eSIM-only models' ONLY to the 36 h / 45 h video-playback figures. The 30 h sits in a separate, unqualified sentence: 'On iPhone 18 Pro Max, five minutes of wired charging provides around seven hours of video playback, and based on a new battery usage model that leverages real-world data, it provides up to 30 hours of usage on a full charge.' Nothing there says eSIM-only. The TW page gives 29 hours for the same unqualified sentence, so the US/TW gap on THIS number is not explained by the eSIM-only +2 hours. Recording it inside the eSIM-only clause puts a condition on the page that Apple did not write, and would propagate into the article as a wrong qualifier.

unsupported.fact: iOS 27 於 2026 年 9 月 14 日以「免費軟體更新」形式推出 (cited to the TW URL)
unsupported.why: The TW page says 「以免額外付費軟體更新的形式提供」 (free of additional charge). Only the US page says 'free software update'. Cited to the TW URL this is a paraphrase, not what that page says. Use 「免額外付費軟體更新」 with the TW source.

unsupported.fact: 當天沒有 Apple Watch SE 的新聞稿 (fact 2)
unsupported.why: True of the feed I fetched, but it is a negative inference from a 20-entry rolling window and it is misleading as written. Apple Watch SE 3 IS named inside these same 9/9 releases — in the watchOS 27 compatibility list (「Apple Watch Series 9 或後續錶款、Apple Watch SE 3，或 Apple Watch Ultra 2 或後續錶款」) and in the TW promo footnote (「購買 Apple Watch Series 12、Apple Watch SE 3 或 Apple Watch Ultra 4…」). apple.com/tw/watchos/feature-availability groups SE 3 with Series 11 / Ultra 3, i.e. the previous generation. If this reaches the article it must say 'no separate 9/9 press release for an SE model', never 'there is no Apple Watch SE'.

unsupported.fact: Nine facts are traced to US newsroom URLs that are not in sources[] (structural)
unsupported.why: sources[] holds four TW URLs only, but the recorded facts on US pricing, the US region list, mmWave, eSIM-only battery and regions, iPhone Handoff and the testing footnote all point at www.apple.com/newsroom/… The BRIEF requires every fact to point at one of the (max 4) sources, so those nine are currently untraceable from the content pack. The researcher flagged it but left the decision to the writer, which is not good enough. Note the testing-conditions footnote (July 2026 charging, August 2026 battery, preproduction units) exists VERBATIM on the TW page — 「測試由 Apple 於 2026 年 7 月…」 / 「…2026 年 8 月…」 — so that one should simply be re-pointed at the TW URL and costs no source slot.

Flagging even though it resolves, as instructed. This URL is not linked from any of the four press releases: I grepped all four TW pages and the only feature-availability link any of them carries is apple.com/tw/ios/feature-availability, on the iPhone page. The watchOS path looks derived by analogy from the iOS one. It is a genuine official Apple page and the researcher did fetch and read it, so it is usable, but the research record should state how it was found rather than leaving it looking constructed.

additional_findings: The region-list swap is recorded only half-way. The TW iPhone list names 台灣 but DROPS Türkiye; the US list names Türkiye but drops Taiwan. Same on the watches: US Series 12 / Ultra 4 say 'Australia, Canada, France, Germany, India, Japan, the UAE, the UK, the U.S., and more than 50 other countries', TW says 「澳洲、加拿大、法國、德國、印度、日本、台灣、英國、美國等超過 50 個國家和地區」 (台灣 in, 阿拉伯聯合大公國 out). These are localised example lists, not different region sets — the article must not present either as the full list.

TW-only regulatory footnote, identical on BOTH watch pages, and the single most Taiwan-relevant fact in the batch: 「Apple Watch Series 12 或 Ultra 4 上的高血壓通知功能在台灣不會一開始就推出，因為該功能於這些型號的其他法規核准程序仍在進行中。預計將於明年推出。詳情請參閱功能供應狀態說明：support.apple.com/zh-tw/118210。」 Apple gives no month and names no regulator.

Neither US watch page contains the string 'hypertension' even once (0 matches in both raw HTML files), and the TW pages mention 高血壓 only in that footnote, never in the body. None of the four press releases explains what the feature does. Any description of hypertension notifications must come from another official Apple page or be left out entirely.

apple.com/tw/watchos/feature-availability corroborates the footnote but adds no date: 台灣 carries footnote 7, 「…尚待監管機構進行額外的審核」. The 「預計將於明年推出」 timeline exists ONLY in the press-release footnote, so attribute it there.

Apple Watch Series 12, read by me: NT$13,900 起 / $399 (U.S.); 預訂 即日起 (9/9), 供貨 9 月 18 日; 超過 50 個國家和地區; S11 + 「健康感測系統」; 全天候每五秒測量一次心率; HRV 測量頻率最高可達以往的 24 倍; 「準備指數」 0 至 10 分，四種建議 「恢復」「量力而為」「準備就緒」「全力以赴」; 日常續航 24 小時、室外體能訓練 10 小時 (較上一代 +25%)、充電 15 分鐘可增加最長 12 小時 (較上一代 +50%); 鋁金屬錶款採用超瓷晶盾 2，較 Ion-X 提升 60%; 環境 40% 再生材料、鋁金屬錶殼 100% 再生鋁、3D 列印鈦金屬錶殼 100% 再生鈦. All accuracy / 「最精準」 wording is an Apple claim resting on a 逾 1,000 人 study Apple ran.
Apple Watch Ultra 4, read by me: NT$27,900 起 / $799 (U.S.); 預訂 即日起, 供貨 9 月 18 日; 超過 50 個國家和地區; 連續追蹤室外體能訓練最長 45 小時; 「運動手錶中最精準的裝置端 GPS」 (Apple claim); 原色與黑色鈦金屬.

AirPods 5, read by me: NT$4,490 標準款 / NT$5,190 搭配無線充電盒 (更長續航、耳機柄音量控制); US $129 / $149; 供貨 9 月 18 日. Note the counts differ: TW says 「包括台灣在內等超過 65 個國家與地區」, US says 'the U.S. and more than 65 OTHER countries and regions'. Do not merge the two.

Dated future commitments the visible facts omit: (a) SynthID — body says 「影像後設資料和即將支援的 SynthID 標準，也能協助使用者辨識由 AI 生成或編輯的影像」 and the footnote says 「SynthID 將於今年稍晚透過軟體更新推出，並會視採用的編輯方式，套用於大多數經過編輯的影像」. The recorded Apple Reference Image fact drops SynthID entirely. (b) Both watch pages: S11 「也將支援於今年稍晚推出的全新功能，協助失聰或重聽使用者留意重要聲音」.

US iPhone footnote 159 is broader than the Apple Intelligence footnote that was quoted: 'Siri AI will not be available initially in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS. Features that rely on Siri AI will also not be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.' The quoted footnote covers iOS only.

US-only commercial items with their own dates, none recorded: Apple Upgrade (a leasing program provided by Klarna, U.S. only) from $34.99/month for iPhone 18 Pro and $11.99/month for Series 12; three months of Apple One free for new and qualified returning subscribers 'beginning September 17'; AppleCare One and AppleCare One Family. September 17 is a fourth distinct date alongside 9/9, 9/12, 9/14, 9/18 and 9/25.
TW-only promo on the watch pages: 「購買 Apple Watch Series 12、Apple Watch SE 3 或 Apple Watch Ultra 4 的新訂閱者，可免費享有三個月的 Apple Fitness+ 和 Apple Music。優惠與服務適用狀況因區域而異。」
iCloud+ entry price differs by market on the same release: TW 「每月最低只需 NT$30」 vs US '$0.99 (U.S.) per month'. Use the TW figure with the TW source if it is mentioned at all.

The TW Ultra 4 page (feed <updated> 2026-09-11T21:53:40.438Z, page date line still 2026 年 9 月 9 日) carries a visible editing artifact in the heart-rate paragraph: 「帶來穿戴式裝置中最精準的心率感測功能透過針對超過千名多元參與者進行嚴謹的科學研究…」, with the footnote marker and sentence break missing, unlike the parallel Series 12 sentence. Further evidence it was revised after publication — re-fetch before quoting it.

Date hygiene for the pack: announcement 2026-09-09 (all eight pages and both feeds agree); iPhone 18 Pro pre-order 2026-09-12 — 「台灣時間 9 月 12 日 (星期六) 晚上 8 點」 and '5 a.m. PT this Saturday, September 12' are the SAME moment written two ways, do not present them as two events; Watch and AirPods pre-order 2026-09-09 (即日起); software 2026-09-14; first-wave availability 2026-09-18; Apple One offer 2026-09-17; second-wave iPhone availability 2026-09-25 (其他 20 個國家和地區). news_date and the slug suffix should both be 2026-09-09.

Positive note for the record, since the brief asks whether any fact rests on a non-first-party page: none does. Every source is apple.com or support.apple.com, no news outlet, aggregator, law-firm blog or search snippet appears anywhere in the record, and the researcher's own documented method for the TW AirPods slug (read it out of the TW feed rather than guessing 'with' vs 'featuring') is exactly right — I confirmed the two slugs genuinely differ.
